o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یلكن (yẹlken), from Proto-Turkic *yẹlken. Cognate with Turkish yelken.
Izafet II compound of damaq + ön. Calque of Russian передненёбный (perednenjóbnyj).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دپمك (depmek), from Proto-Turkic *tep- (“to stamp, tramp”).
